rationale: The stock gapped down ~9.2% on a positive news article published 845 minutes ago, suggesting the gap reflects a separate catalyst (likely a dilutive financing event tied to the $750M raise) that has already been partially absorbed. Price is sitting mid-range (46%) with no clear directional momentum — the last 5 candles show choppy, low-volume action with a sharp dip on the 4th candle and partial recovery, indicating indecision rather than a tradeable trend. With 17.9x relative volume already fading and no clear structural level to lean against for a defined-risk entry, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure alongside existing committed capital.
